popCulture.title: Manto (daughter of Tiresias)
popCulture.description: Theban prophetess, daughter of Tiresias — captive after the Epigoni, mother of Mopsus in some lines, and in Italian tradition the eponym behind Mantua.

popCulture.title: Thebaid
popCulture.creator: Statius
popCulture.description: Statius’ epic keeps Manto beside blind Tiresias in Theban rites — the seer’s daughter as ritual voice before the city’s fall.
